Technical Architect / Senior Technical Architect- DevOps (Missionforce)
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         Salesforce Professional Services is hiring Technical Architects with a DevOps focus to join the Missionforce team. As a Technical Architect, you will be serving as a strategic advisor and Salesforce product and platform expert to the company’s largest, most complex customers in the Defense & National Security space.     The DevOps Technical Architect / Senior Technical Architect plays a pivotal role in both presales and implementation, shaping, scoping, and solutioning engagements to set customers up for success. This leader provides technical oversight and execution leadership on large-scale and mission-critical engagements while also serving as a trusted mentor to Salesforce teams and Federal clients. They're responsible for driving architectural excellence, strategic customer alignment, and fostering a high-performance culture within their teams.     Your Impact     Serve as a trusted DevOps technical advisor to the client    In this client-facing architectural role, you will advise, design, and manage the deployment of enterprise DevOps strategies, CI/CD orchestration pipelines, release governance models, and sandbox/production workflows    Design, build, and optimize automated CI/CD pipelines leveraging Salesforce-native release tools (e.g., DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset, Flosum, AutoRABIT) alongside general-purpose CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure DevOps    Establish source-driven development workflows and Git branching strategies aligned with Salesforce modular architectures using SFDX, Metadata API, and Unlocked Packaging    Architect sandbox management frameworks, including refresh cycles, pre-refresh automation, and anonymized test data loading compliant with data security and privacy regulations (especially in Data Cloud-connected environments    Implement static code analysis, automated pre-checks, security policies, and compliance validations within CI/CD pipelines to establish robust DevSecOps practices    Evaluate customer DevOps processes, build/deployment pipelines, and organizational maturity; deliver actionable recommendations aligned with Salesforce best practices    Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise   Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value  Work collaboratively, having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts and creative, prescriptive thinking  Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution  Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners  Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track, while ensuring solutions are extendable and maintainable going forward  Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs  Contribute to a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies on enabling technologies including the Salesforce Platform      Minimum Requirements    8+ years enterprise architecture or consulting experience on the Salesforce Platform  Ability to define overall deployment orchestration plans, principles, objectives, and tactics  Proficiency in setting up version control repositories and designing repository branch structures  Ability to evaluate CI/CD pipeline maturity and provide recommendations to achieve customer business goals  Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills  Strong presentation skills. Able to effectively present and defend a point of view to a variety of audiences  Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies  Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience  A great listener with the ability to connect with people in diverse roles  Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration  Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems  Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation and your obtaining and maintaining the specific level of U.S. Government security clearance required for this role. U.S. citizenship (U.S. born or naturalized) required.      Preferred Requirements    Metro DC located  Active Clearance (Secret, TS, TS/SCI or TS/SCI with Poly)  Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or multiple Salesforce Architecture certifications  Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)  Experience in public sector digital transformation initiatives  Hands-on experience with Public Sector Solutions (“Agentforce Public Sector”)  Ability to convey and convince customers of best practices at various levels within a large organization  Application design and development background  Travel may be required and varies depending on the client requirements     NOTE: By applying to the Technical Architect posting, recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring Technical Consultant will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.       This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position. title: Principal Architect
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Sales    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.          Principal, AI & Integrated Solutions Architect — Financial Services      Regulated Industries Architecture · Salesforce · Grade 8     About the role    Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.    As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.    You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.    What you’ll do     Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%).  Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.     Build to prove value (≈25%).  Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.     Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%).  Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.     Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%).  Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.     Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%).  Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.     Elevate the team and the field (≈10%).  Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.    What success looks like     Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.    Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.    Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.    Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.    Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited.     What you’ll bring     10+ years in enterprise or solution architecture, including significant customer-facing work in financial services: banking, insurance, wealth/asset management, or payments.    Deep hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Financial Services Cloud, Service/Sales Cloud, Data 360) and enterprise integration, ideally MuleSoft and API-led design.    Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.    Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code (Apex, JavaScript/Node, Python, or similar) and AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.    Working knowledge of FS regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.    Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.    A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.     Nice to have     Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Application/System Architect, or progress toward CTA.    Experience on the customer or SI side of large FS transformations.    Exposure to process intelligence or agentic operations tooling.    Published points of view, conference talks, or open reusable assets.      Required Qualifications     B.S Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS    Knowledge of related applications, relational databases, and ERP technologies    Strong oral, written, presentation, collaboration, and interpersonal communication skills    Ability to work as part of a team to solve technical problems in varied political environments    Minimum of 4 years of professional experience.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Sr Principal Enterprise Solution Architect
description_html: Sr Principal Enterprise Solution Architect        This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE partner/customer office.                                                       Who We Are:                                                                                                     Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                                                        Job Description:         Drive Enterprise Transformation at Executive Level   Are you an experienced Enterprise Architect who thrives at the intersection of business strategy and technology innovation?     We are seeking a  Senior Principal Enterprise Solutions Architect  to help shape the future IT landscape of our customers. In this highly visible leadership role, you will partner with C-level executives, business leaders, and technology teams to define enterprise-wide transformation strategies that deliver measurable business outcomes.  You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, helping organizations navigate complex technology challenges, modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, security requirements, and large-scale digital transformation programs.  This role combines deep architectural expertise with executive consulting, strategic planning, and thought leadership across enterprise environments.    What You'll Do    Lead enterprise transformation initiatives for medium-sized and large organizations.  Develop long-term technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and organizational goals.  Engage with CIOs, CTOs, business executives, and senior stakeholders to define future-state architectures.  Guide customers through cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization, data protection, security, and operational excellence initiatives.  Drive enterprise architecture governance and technology decision frameworks.  Assess emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that support business growth.  Facilitate executive workshops and advisory sessions.  Lead architecture teams across complex, multi-disciplinary programs.  Develop business cases, transformation strategies, and operating models.  Act as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.  Collaborate with solution architects, delivery teams, consulting teams, and account executives to ensure successful outcomes.  Support strategic pursuits, bid activities, and executive presentations for large and complex opportunities.     What We're Looking For     Required Experience    15+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, IT Strategy, or Digital Transformation.  Extensive experience advising executive stakeholders.  Proven track record delivering enterprise-wide technology transformation programs.  Experience operating within highly complex business and IT environments.  Strong understanding of business strategy and organizational change.  Experience leading large, geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.  Experience influencing enterprise technology investment decisions.     Technical Expertise   Strong experience across several of the following areas:   Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, ArchiMate)  Cloud Transformation (Azure, AWS, Hybrid Cloud)  Enterprise Infrastructure  Data Protection & Resiliency  Security & Compliance  Digital Transformation  Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery  Enterprise Storage Platforms  Strategic IT Planning  Governance & Operating Models  Application & Infrastructure Modernization  Technology Portfolio Management     Consulting & Leadership   The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with exceptional stakeholder management skills.  You will:   Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders.  Challenge existing ways of working and drive meaningful change.  Translate complex technical topics into business value.  Navigate competing stakeholder interests and political landscapes.  Lead executive-level conversations regarding technology investments and transformation priorities.  Influence decisions without direct authority.  Guide organizations through organizational and technological change.     Key Success Factors   You are someone who can walk into a customer meeting where the challenge seems vague or undefined and uncover the real business problem.  You know how to:   Ask the right questions.  Identify strategic opportunities.  Connect business objectives with technology capabilities.  Build consensus among stakeholders.  Guide customers through difficult transformation journeys.  Create clarity within highly complex environments.     Preferred Qualifications    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.  Understanding of Architectural concept.   Experience working within enterprise consulting or global systems integration environments.  Experience presenting at executive and industry events.  Proven thought leadership within architecture communities.            Accessibility    HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. title: Senior Datacenter Technical Program Manager, At-Scale AI Clusters
description_html: NVIDIA is looking for a highly-motivated Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Applied Systems Engineering Team to drive datacenter integration for the next generation of NVIDIA AI supercomputing systems. This TPM will play a crucial role throughout the lifecycle of the latest AI systems at scale, from datacenter design and requirements definition, through systems integration of AI clusters into the datacenter environment, and support for these systems as they enter production.    This role will drive collaboration between engineering leaders across multiple hardware and software teams, helping us work together to build AI supercomputers for NVIDIA engineers and develop reference architectures to advise customers and partners.     What you’ll be doing:     Collaborate with outstanding engineers and architects to build and deploy large scale GPU computing systems based on NVIDIA's reference supercomputing architectures    Lead the integration of new AI clusters with datacenter facilities with demanding requirements on power, cooling, and instrumentation    Coordinate design and fit-out of new datacenter builds, working with both internal engineering teams and external contractors    Own and produce detailed documentation for the end-to-end process for datacenter fit-out and integration    Communicate internally with engineering leadership to prioritize and address key issues essential to the success of our largest customers       What we need to see:     BS in Applied Science or Engineering (or equivalent experience)    8+ years of overall experience    Experience with high-performance computing systems and GPU clusters deployed in on-premises datacenters    A passion for understanding challenging technical problems and driving the process of finding a solution    Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, to facilitate building a collaborative workflow for coordination between many teams       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Understanding of datacenter design, including familiarity with power and cooling technologies    Expertise in system monitoring and instrumentation of large clusters, using technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Modbus, and BACNet    Experience working with the engineering or academic research community supporting high-performance computing or deep learning       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 22, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
